title: Concept: Pickle deserialization (python)
description: Python pickle loads execute callables named in the byte stream, so bytes from an attacker are code execution. The remedy is JSON or a typed schema with validation.
applicability: Python code that loads pickle data from files, caches, queues, or network sources; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Remote code execution when untrusted bytes reach a pickle load; HIGH severity.
